observations.behavior: Adds a helper that retries event production up to 60 times when the local Kafka queue is full, flushing and retrying instead of immediately failing.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help demo or staging environments where broker throughput lags behind generation, preventing immediate failure while still eventually surfacing persistent outages.

observations.behavior: Replaces direct calls to create_event with the new wrapper in batch processing; retains original parameters but adds bounded backoff before propagating errors.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how simulated events are persisted during matrix runs, potentially improving completion rates under temporary broker pressure without changing end-user-facing behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds unit tests covering three scenarios: success on first try, multiple flushes until room appears, and exhaustion after max attempts raising an error.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new retry behavior, though this remains isolated to the demo backend rather than shared infrastructure.

observations.limitations: All changes reside within products/demo/backend. No evidence shows deployment, configuration, or adoption. The helper does not change core PostHog ingestion paths, only a simulation runner's handling of transient Kafka queue fills.

review.posthog_relevance: Could help prevent failed demo runs when brokers temporarily lag, avoiding false negatives while still surfacing persistent failures.
